title: A Stochastic Optimization Approach to Control-Affine Optimal Control Problems
summary: We consider control-affine optimal control problems on the torus, where the dynamics and cost functions are only accessed through samples. Starting from a weak formulation of such problems, we derive a dual, a primal, and a primal-dual formulation, compatible with stochastic optimization. We show convergence of stochastic first-order methods to the optimal value under generic conditions. In addition, we introduce a computable metric that upper-bounds the performance of suboptimal controllers produced during optimization, under additional regularity assumptions.
